Chapter 845: Chapter 35: Vast Chaos (Please Subscribe)

Inside the territory of the Star Alliance.

On a massive planet, the real bodies of the Four Divine Kings, towering a million miles high, sat quietly.

Since the curtain fell on the Two-dimensional World, ‘White Paper’ had escaped the Cosmic Starry Skies.

The Four Divine Kings had been sitting here ever since.

The avatar’s fall in the Two-dimensional World dealt a heavy blow to the Four Divine Kings.

It was far more than just a permanent loss of a part of their spirit will,

and the loss of a supremely powerful weapon suited for them.

More importantly, the mental state of the Four Divine Kings was severely stimulated.

As a Level Eleven Perfect legendary powerhouse, a unique life form in the Cosmic Starry Skies.

The Four Divine Kings would not dare to claim they were the strongest among Level Eleven, but they were certainly notable.

Yet, in the Two-dimensional World, being utterly crushed by the human civilization’s ‘Xueyu’ was unbearable for the Four Divine Kings.

The evolvers of human civilization were inherently feeble.

Ninety-nine percent of them could not even step into the First Layer, starting who knows how much lower compared to special life forms.

Yet, the Four Divine Kings, had been defeated by such a human evolver.

If it was only a defeat, the Four Divine Kings would not have been greatly shaken.

Human civilization’s evolvers might start low, but they possess a high potential, otherwise, how could they produce nine Level Twelve evolvers?

But the Four Divine Kings faced a crushing defeat, or rather, it couldn’t even be considered a defeat.

In the eyes of that human ‘Xueyu’, the Four Divine Kings were not even considered an opponent.

At that moment.

A voice transmitted into the planet, resonating in this space-time.

“Four Divine Kings, the past is the past, there’s no need to dwell on it.”

The voice of the strongest being from the Star Alliance came.

“Strongest being, in our universe, does there really exist such a monstrous Level Eleven life?”

The Four Divine Kings still found it hard to comprehend.

“Anything is possible.”

The strongest being from the Star Alliance was silent for a moment and then said: “That Two-dimensional World, it could only completely suppress the powers below Level Twelve.”

“Perhaps, that human ‘Xueyu’ had carried some artifact that allowed him to break free from the suppression of the Two-dimensional World to some extent.”

The strongest being from the Star Alliance slowly said.

This was also the conjecture of many pinnacle race powerhouses and ultimate beings during their reassessment after ‘White Paper’ escaped the universe, about why that human ‘Xueyu’s’ strength was so exceptionally high.

The capability of the human ‘Xueyu’ to make the Four Divine Kings tremble with merely a glance, was not something a normal Level Eleven could demonstrate.

Hearing this, the Four Divine Kings felt slightly more relieved inside.

If it’s just as the strongest being speculated, then perhaps, their defeat wasn’t too disgraceful?

“Four Divine Kings, what you need to consider now is the upcoming massive battlefield.”

“To open this massive battlefield, both the Star Alliance and other pinnacle races have paid a significant price.”

The strongest being from the Star Alliance looked down upon the Four Divine Kings, “As long as we can obtain the initial dominance of that massive Battlefields of Different Races, I can make sure that the part of your spirit will that was lost will be compensated as much as possible.”

Any life that perishes in the Two-dimensional World inside White Paper will permanently lose a part of their spirit will.

This part of spirit will, cannot be recovered, but it can be compensated through certain means, it’s just a matter of cost.

“Thank you, strongest being. In the forthcoming massive battlefield, I will give it my all.”

The Four Divine Kings said solemnly.

“That’s good.”

The strongest being from the Star Alliance nodded slightly, “After this experience, once you have compensated, your foundation will be almost sufficient, you can attempt to breakthrough to the ultimate Level Twelve.”

“Attempt to breakthrough Level Twelve?”

The eyes of the Four Divine Kings slightly glimmered.

For any Level Eleven life, the sole target is to achieve the ultimate Level Twelve.

Only by stepping into ultimate Level Twelve, can one break free from the confines of the river of time, hoping to live through one Cosmic Era after another.

“No need to worry about that human ‘Xueyu’, perhaps on the path of attempting the ultimate, he might not be as good as you.” The strongest being from the Star Alliance said.

“Yes.”

The Four Divine Kings nodded, their gaze regaining confidence.

“You…”

The strongest being from the Star Alliance was about to continue saying something.

Suddenly—

A mighty Origin Source aura swept across the entire universe.

“This?”

The expression of the strongest being from the Star Alliance turned grave, his gaze leisurely looking towards a certain direction.

“Is a life attempting the ultimate?”

The Four Divine Kings also realized, this Origin Source aura was vast and boundless, even Level Eleven life could clearly feel it.

Only the attempt at the ultimate could cause such an instantaneous arrival of the Chaos Void Origin.

Recently, a Tenth Rank Evolver from human civilization comprehended the Rule of Time, attempted Level Eleven, also inducing the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, but the disturbance was much smaller than now.

“Who is attempting the ultimate?”

The Four Divine Kings looked towards the strongest being.

They could only feel the vast and omnipresent Chaos Void Origin aura, but as for the source, blocked by a gigantic Spatial-Temporal Maze, the Four Divine Kings couldn’t be sure.

“Within the territory of human civilization…”

The strongest being from the Star Alliance was silent for a moment, with the perception of level twelve, barely penetrating the Spatial-Temporal Maze, managed to approximately locate the source of the Chaos Void Origin near the human civilization’s territory.

“Human civilization’s territory? Is that ‘Xueyu’ attempting the ultimate?”

The Four Divine Kings paused, this thought unconsciously emerging in their minds.

…

Mighty and overwhelming, the waves of Chaos Void Origin fluctuations swept across, in an instant attracting the attention of all Level Twelve beings within the Cosmic Starry Skies, numerous Level Eleven powerhouses also abruptly realized.
